\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Tensorization}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Cube.Reverse.Tensorization
\section{Overview}
Mixed power means permit a one-bit reverse inequality to extend to every cube dimension. Further noise increases every extended power mean with exponent less than one.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Minkowski inequality for finite sums]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.finset_Lr_sum_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
Let $I,K$ be sets, let $r\in\bbr$ with $1\le r$, and let $s\subseteq I$ and $t\subseteq
K$ be finite. Suppose $a:I\times K\to\bbr$ satisfies $a(i,j)\ge0$ for every $i\in s$ and
$j\in t$. Then $\displaystyle\left(\sum_{j\in t}\left(\sum_{i\in
s}a(i,j)\right)^r\right)^{1/r}\le\sum_{i\in s}\left(\sum_{j\in t}a(i,j)^r\right)^{1/r}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Mixed power-mean comparison]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.reverse_minkowski_mixed}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.finset_Lr_sum_le, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_of_pos, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.expect_eq_fintypeExpect, BooleanAnalysis.uniformWeight}
\difficulty{5}
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $0<q\le p$ be real numbers, and let
$F:\{0,1\}^n\times\{0,1\}\to\mathbb R$ be nonnegative. Taking all means with respect to
the uniform measures on the indicated cubes, one has $M_q\bigl(x\mapsto M_p(y\mapsto
F(x,y))\bigr)\ge M_p\bigl(y\mapsto M_q(x\mapsto F(x,y))\bigr)$, where the inner means
use the one-dimensional cube and the outer means use the $n$-dimensional cube.
\end{lemma}

\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube, BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsNonnegative, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_collapse_last, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_comm, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_dim_zero, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_mono, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.lpMean_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_dim_zero, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_nonneg, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.noiseOp_snoc_slice, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.restrictLast, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.reverse_minkowski_mixed, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{5}
Let $p,q,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<q<p$ and $0\le\rho\le1$. Suppose that for every
nonnegative real-valued function $u$ on the one-dimensional Boolean cube, $M_q(T_\rho
u)\ge M_p(u)$. Then for every natural number $n$ and every nonnegative real-valued
function $f$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, $M_q(T_\rho f)\ge M_p(f)$, where $T_\rho$ is the
Walsh–Fourier noise operator and $M_r$ is the extended power mean defined for cube
functions.
\end{theorem}
